div.head: Af 29
div.ab: XXIII. Gif mon twyhyndne mon unsynnigne ofslea mid hloþe, gilde se (ðe) þæs sleges ondetta sy wer ⁊ wite; ⁊ æghwylc ðara ðe on ðæm syþe wære geselle XXX scll' to hloþbote.
XXIIII. Gif mon twyhyndne mon unsynnigne mid hloðe ófslea, gielde se ðæs sleges andetta sie wer ⁊ wite; ⁊ æghwelc mon ðe on siðe wære geselle XXX scill. to hloðbote.
Si quis hominem twihindum innocentem cum hloðe (id est cohorte) occidat, reddat qui ictum confitebitur weram et witam; et omnis, qui interfuerit, reddat XXX sol. de hloþbota.
{XXIIII} Gif mon twyhyndne mon unsynnigne mid hloðe ofslea, gielde se ðæs sleges andetta sie wer ⁊ wite; ⁊ æghwelc mon ðe on siðe wære geselle XXX scill to hloðbote.

If someone in a band slays an innocent 200-[wergild] man, let him who admits the slaying pay wer and fine; and let each man who was on the expedition add 30 shillings as compensation for taking part in the band.

If one of a band of marauders slays an unoffending man, whose wergeld is 200 shillings, he who acknowledges the blow shall pay the wergeld and the fine; and everyone engaged in the affair shall pay 30 shillings compensation for belonging to such a band.

If anyone with a band of men kills an innocent man of a two-hundred wergild, he who admits the slaying is to pay the wergild and the fine, and each man who was in that expedition is to pay 30 shillings as compensation for being in that band.

Wenn jemand mit einer Bande einen unschuldigen 200-[Schilling-]Mann erschlägt, so zahle, wer des Todtschlags geständig ist, das Wergeld [des Erschlagenen an dessen Sippe] und Strafgeld [an den Richter]; und jeder Mann, der bei [diesem] Zuge war, zahle 30 Schill. als Bandenbusse.

If someone with a band slays an innocent 200-[shilling] man, let whoever confesses to the slaying pay the wergeld [of the slain, to his kin] and the fine [to the judge]; and let every man who was on [that] expedition pay 30 shillings as band-compensation.
div.note: The figures in brackets are those retained by Liebermann from earlier editors who rearranged the MS. order. Attenborough numbers straight on.
Whitelock numbers this chapter 29 and gives Liebermann’s number, 29, in brackets.
